title: Power side-channel leakage localization in an S-box datapath
description: Analyze a single-round substitution/permutation datapath (plaintext-to-key-mix-to-S-box-to-diffusion) together with a Hamming-distance power model, and report which registers exhibit measurable data-dependent switching activity across a provided input vector set, along with hardening recommendations for any flagged signals.
output_summary: A single JSON file at submission/vulnerability_report.json containing a 'signals' array (signal_name, hd_variance, flagged, optional notes) covering every register documented in design_brief.md, and a 'recommendations' array (target_signal, technique, rationale) proposing hardening for flagged signals.
